description: This file defines the DetailedTimesheet class within the OrangeHRM Time module, serving as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) to encapsulate a detailed view of a timesheet, including its associated rows and columns.

classes.name: DetailedTimesheet
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) that encapsulates a timesheet, its rows, and columns for detailed representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DetailedTimesheet with a Timesheet entity, rows, and columns.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Retrieves the array of TimesheetRow objects.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Retrieves the array of TimesheetColumn objects.
